item.title: [7.3] RBI bond sales, FX intervention help halve India's cash overhang
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Bond yields for Indian government securities showed little fluctuation as markets brace for ongoing liquidity withdrawals. Specifically, the yield for the benchmark 2036 bond settled at about 7.05% during early trading on Tuesday. With retail inflation rising to 4.82% in August, expectations mount for a rate hike from the Reserve Bank of India next month.

WHY IT MATTERS

The successful reduction of India's liquidity overhang via RBI interventions and rising inflation pressures signal a potentially hawkish shift in monetary policy relevant to regional market participants.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Bank of Korea board member Chang Yong-sung signaled a data-driven approach to future interest rate hikes, emphasizing inflation, economic growth, and financial stability. The remarks follow the central bank's recent 25 basis point rate hike to 3.00% on August 27 as policymakers act to contain financial imbalances.

item.description:
